jobs.listSubtitle: Track drafts, open bids, live trips, and completed jobs.

jobs.emptyHint: Create a job to get carrier bids.
jobs.createHint: Start with where the load goes, then what you're shipping.
jobs.editHint: Update cargo details before accept and payment.
jobs.editDraftOnly: Only draft jobs can be edited.
jobs.editNotAllowed: This job can no longer be edited.
jobs.editReceiverHint: Receiver details can be changed until the driver arrives at drop-off.
jobs.pricingHourlyHint: Time-based quote for a single pickup → dropoff.
jobs.distanceKmHint: Enter route distance. Suggested from pickup and drop when available.
jobs.distanceKmSuggesting: Suggesting distance from pickup and drop…
jobs.distanceKmSuggestFailed: Could not auto-suggest distance — enter the route km manually.
jobs.estimateRangeHint: Typical range for this load class vs next larger vehicle: {{min}} – {{max}} inc GST (guidance; final price is the accepted bid).
jobs.estimateForClassHint: Estimated {{amount}} inc GST for class {{class}} (final price is the accepted bid).
jobs.distanceKmSuggested: Suggested from pickup/drop: {{km}} km (you can edit).
jobs.cargoDimensionsSubtitle: Enter cargo weight and bounding dimensions to compute chargeable weight and suitable vehicles.
jobs.vehicleSelectionSubtitle: Available fleet vehicle classes. Smaller classes are disabled when your cargo exceeds their limits.
jobs.chargeableOverLimitNotice: Chargeable weight exceeds {{max}} kg (50 t). Vehicle class is not suggested until you reduce weight or dimensions.
jobs.extraDropReceiversHint: Optional contacts for extra drop-offs (defaults to the primary receiver above).

siteAccess.sectionDesc: To prevent futile trips and driver delays, Senders must complete a mandatory site assessment before publishing the job.
siteAccess.tightStreetDesc: Narrow street, tight turning circle, residential or restricted access
siteAccess.standardIndustrialDesc: Standard commercial / industrial park street and articulated access
siteAccess.wideYardDesc: Spacious distribution yard or depot with drive-through turnaround
siteAccess.raisedDockDesc: Standard 48-52" dock height for level pallet roll-on loading
siteAccess.groundLevelDesc: Driveway, flat hardstand, or pavement ground loading
siteAccess.forkliftRequiredDesc: Site requires dedicated forklift / mechanical equipment to unload

wizard.pricingHint: Choose how this job is priced and confirm route distance.
wizard.cargoHint: Enter weight and dimensions so we can recommend a vehicle class.
wizard.receiverHint: Who should receive the load at drop-off.
wizard.routeHint: Set how this job is priced and confirm route stops.
wizard.loadHint: Enter what you're shipping — weight, dimensions, and load type.
wizard.truckHint: Select the minimum vehicle class and review price guidance.
wizard.confirmHint: Review the details, accept the site disclaimer, then save.
wizard.journeyAfterDraft: Save draft → Publish → Carriers bid → You accept & pay → Track delivery.

jobs.exceptionBannerHint: Your carrier was notified. Updates are never silent — you will get email when crew changes, continues, or releases.
jobs.exceptionRejectSuccess: Replacement rejected. Job cancelled and refund started.
jobs.exceptionRejectConfirm: Reject this replacement? The job will be cancelled and the fare refunded.
jobs.hardFloorHint: Absolute minimum (hard floor): {{ex}} ex GST · {{inc}} inc GST — publish and bids cannot go below this.
jobs.hardFloorHintIncOnly: Absolute minimum (hard floor): {{inc}} inc GST — publish and bids cannot go below this.
jobs.floorBelowEstimate: Current estimate ({{est}}) is below the floor. Publish and bids are blocked until the estimate meets the minimum.
jobs.floorVsEstimateHint: Market estimate {{est}} is above this floor. The estimate is guidance for typical pricing; the hard floor is only the absolute minimum.
jobs.noBidsYet: No bids yet. Open this job after a carrier submits a bid (email notification is sent).

view.carrierMaskedHint: Carrier and driver details are shared on the completion invoice after delivery.
view.dgVerifiedMasked: Dangerous Goods documents verified for this offer.

jobs.paymentMethodRequired: Complete card payment to lock this assignment.
jobs.pendingPaymentResumeHint: Bid accepted — complete card payment to lock this assignment so the carrier can begin the trip.
jobs.paymentModalSubtitle: Enter your card details below to pay the accepted fare and lock the carrier for this shipment.
jobs.paymentSaveCardHint: Your card will be securely saved via Stripe for future job bookings and approved trip surcharges.
jobs.paymentFailed: Payment could not be completed. Check your card details and try again.
jobs.idempotentReplay: Already confirmed — you were not charged again
jobs.scaRequired: Your bank needs a quick extra check. Complete it below.
jobs.scaBody: Click the button to open your bank’s verification (SMS or app). When it succeeds, we lock the job for the carrier.
jobs.scaFailed: Bank verification failed. Try again or use another card.
jobs.scaStripeMissing: We couldn’t open secure payment. Please refresh and try again, or contact support.
jobs.scaMissingPublishable: We couldn’t open bank verification right now. Please refresh and try again, or contact support.
jobs.scaUnexpectedStatus: We couldn’t finish payment ({{status}}). Please try again or contact support.
jobs.acceptPaymentPending: Payment is still processing. Please wait a moment and refresh.
jobs.acceptPaymentFailed: Payment didn’t go through. Please try again or use another card.

loadTypes.title: Type of Load
loadTypes.subtitle: Choose one freight category (optional Dangerous Goods). A sub-type is selected by default — change it if needed before continuing.
loadTypes.subtypesHint: At least one sub-type is required. Change the default if it is not the closest match.
loadTypes.subtypesRecommended: Select at least one sub-type before continuing.
loadTypes.generalDesc: Cartons, pallets, retail stock, FMCG, general merchandise.
loadTypes.dgDesc: Flammables, toxics, batteries, gas, chemicals (SDS document required).
loadTypes.liquidDesc: Drums, IBCs, oils, bulk liquids (spill containment required).
loadTypes.oversizeDesc: Long steel, pipes, beams (flatbed & permit warnings apply).
loadTypes.steelDesc: Coils, rebar, metal sheets (chains & NHVR restraints required).
loadTypes.reeferDesc: Chilled, frozen, perishable food, pharma (refrigerated unit required).
loadTypes.heavyMachineryDesc: Engines, mining & industrial gear, ramps & high-capacity transport.
loadTypes.vehiclesPlantDesc: Cars, excavators, forklifts, tractors, tilt-tray/ramps required.
loadTypes.timberDesc: Timber packs, plywood, gyprock, bricks, roofing.
loadTypes.highValueDesc: Electronics, medical gear, high-security sensitive freight.
loadTypes.wasteDesc: Industrial/construction waste, scrap, EPA compliance applies.

market.title: Job board
market.payoutFieldHint: Enter what you want to receive for this job (inc GST).
market.emptyHint: Open jobs that match your regions and capabilities will appear here.
market.minPayoutNotice: Minimum payout: {{amount}} inc GST — bids cannot go below this for the selected vehicle.
market.bidBelowFloor: Your payout cannot be below the minimum {{amount}} inc GST
market.errorSelectJobFleet: Please select a job and fleet.
market.errorNeedActiveFleet: You need at least one active vehicle and one active driver to bid.
market.errorVehicleUndersize: That vehicle class is too small for this job.
market.errorVehicleBusy: That vehicle is already committed on another job (open bid, pending accept, or live trip).
market.errorDriverBusy: That driver is already committed on another job (open bid, pending accept, or live trip).
market.driverSuggestedHint: Suggested drivers match licence class for the selected vehicle, schedule, and availability.
market.noSuitableDriver: No active driver matches this vehicle’s licence class, schedule, and availability. Pick another vehicle or update driver licences.
market.noFleetAvailable: No free vehicle/driver pair — finish or withdraw the open bid, or wait for the live trip to complete. Accepting a bid expires conflicting proposals on other jobs for the same vehicle or driver.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.subtitle: Jobs assigned to your fleet
assignments.exceptionsSubtitle: Waiting-time and mass surcharges raised against your trips.
assignments.tripAtDropoffHint: Driver is at drop-off. POD panel below shows signature status.
assignments.podAwaitingExitHint: POD is finalized. Trip completes after the driver leaves the drop-off geofence.
assignments.reassignBody: Swap assets for {{job}}. For breakdowns or driver unavailable, use Exceptions so the sender can approve.
assignments.reassignReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Crew change — continuing with spare truck
assignments.reassignSafetyHint: Changing the driver resets the safety gate so the new driver must re-run NHVR checks.
assignments.reassignSuccessSafetyReset: Assignment reassigned. New driver must pass safety before continuing.
assignments.reassignPickHint: Choose any active fleet unit and driver ({{vehicles}} vehicles · {{drivers}} drivers). Current selection is pre-filled — change both to reassign.
assignments.reassignLoadingFleet: Loading your active fleet and drivers…
assignments.reassignNoActiveVehicles: No ACTIVE vehicles in fleet. Activate a vehicle before reassigning.
assignments.reassignNoActiveDrivers: No ACTIVE drivers. Activate or invite a driver before reassigning.
assignments.reassignBlockedByException: An open trip exception is active. Propose the replacement from Exceptions — the sender must approve before the crew swap.
